page_title: MNT 1-1 CLE | Montpellier v Clermont 29/11/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' Florent Batta shows a yellow card to Maxime Gonalons (Clermont) for his unsportsmanlike behavior after the match has ended.
90+7' Neto Borges (Clermont) receives a red card and walks off the field of play!
90+7' An infringement by Maximiliano Caufriez (Clermont) results in a yellow card and as it's the second time today, he also sees a red and is dismissed by Florent Batta.
90+7' Leo Leroy picks up a yellow card for unsporting behaviour after the half-time whistle. He should have gone straight into the dressing room instead.
90+7' Maxime Esteve (Montpellier) receives a second yellow card and walks off the field of play!
90+7' Having seen unsporting behavior, Florent Batta shows a yellow card to one of the players sitting on the bench. And Maxime Esteve (Montpellier) is the recipient.
90+7' The match has just finished.
90+7' Akor Adams (Montpellier) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
90+3' Becir Omeragic (Montpellier) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
90+3' Arnaud Nordin (Montpellier) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
90' We will have 7 min. of added time.
87' Pascal Gastien decides to make a substitution. Neto Borges will be replaced by Yoel Armougom (Clermont).
87' Substitution. Abdellah Baallal (Clermont) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Habib Keita walks off.
87' 1 - 1 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Teji Savanier (Montpellier) low into the left of the net, giving goalkeeper Mory Diaw no chance!
87' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
85' The referee blows his whistle and gives a penalty!
85' Florent Ogier (Clermont) touches the ball with his hand inside the box!
81' The resulting corner from Teji Savanier (Montpellier) comes to nothing.
79' Montpellier failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

78' The ball from the corner kick lands at the feet of Mousa Al Tamari (Montpellier) deep inside the box and he takes a shot. The strike heads towards the bottom left corner, but it's deflected away thanks to a brilliant intervention by one of the defenders.
78' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.

78' Falaye Sacko (Montpellier) attempts a long crossfield pass, but the defence does well to intercept the ball. The ball goes behind for a corner. Montpellier will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
77' A rebound spins to Sacha Delaye (Montpellier) inside the box, but his sliced shot flies just over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Clermont will have a goal kick.
76' Habib Keita (Clermont) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
74' The main referee, Florent Batta, is apparently not going to tolerate any discussions. Andy Pelmard (Clermont) is given a yellow card for dissent.
73' The goalkeeper pulls off a decent save to deny Mousa Al Tamari (Montpellier) as he jumps for a header from a brilliant cross into the penalty area.
71' Arnaud Nordin (Montpellier) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Wahbi Khazri.
70' That's the end of the game for Theo Sainte-Luce (Montpellier), who is replaced by Enzo Tchato.
69' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Elbasan Rashani (Clermont) is coming onto the pitch as Jim Allevinah cannot continue after picking up an injury.
68' Pascal Gastien has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Mehdi Zeffane (Clermont) replacing Cheick Oumar Konate.
67' The linesman makes the right call and Montpellier will have a corner.
67' Falaye Sacko (Montpellier) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
64' The substitution has been made. Yohan Magnin (Clermont) has replaced Maxime Gonalons.
64' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) collects a pass, sees the keeper off his line and shoots from long range, but the effort is disappointing and goes high over the bar.
61' The ball rebounds to Teji Savanier (Montpellier) inside the box after a goalmouth scramble, but he bends the ball well wide of the right post.

59' This was a piece of cake for Mory Diaw. Khalil Fayad (Montpellier) found himself some space after latching on to a pass, but his strike only went low to the middle of the goal and into the gloves of the prepared keeper.
58' Close! Muhammed Cham (Clermont) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot inches wide of the right post.
57' The resulting corner from Wahbi Khazri (Montpellier) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.

57' Wahbi Khazri (Montpellier) beats the defender inside the box and lashes a shot towards the bottom left corner, but Mory Diaw makes a brilliant reflex save to deny him. Goalkeeping at its best! The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Montpellier.
56' Habib Keita (Clermont) latches onto the ball after a scramble in the box, but his placed effort towards the top of the net is far too weak and Benjamin Lecomte makes a simple save.
54' Akor Adams (Montpellier) finds space inside the box but rifles his effort miles past the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Clermont.
52' Theo Sainte-Luce has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
52' Jim Allevinah (Clermont) receives a well-played pass inside the penalty area and shoots. He sends the ball into orbit.
50' A pass from Wahbi Khazri (Montpellier) is intercepted by Mory Diaw and the move breaks down.
49' Muhammed Cham (Clermont) whips the ball in from the long-range free kick, but the first man gets it clear.
49' Kiki Kouyate (Montpellier) is penalised for holding. Florent Batta signals a set piece.
47' Mousa Al Tamari (Montpellier) tries his luck and takes a shot from inside the box. His effort on goal is blocked by a defender.
46' Falaye Sacko (Montpellier) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
46' The second half has just started.
45+7' The match has reached half-time.
45+6' Jim Allevinah (Clermont) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
45+5' The foul by Jim Allevinah (Clermont) was seen by Florent Batta who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
45+2' Substitution. Sacha Delaye (Montpellier) has come on for Jordan Ferri.
45+2' It doesn’t look good for Jordan Ferri (Montpellier); looks like he’ll have to leave the pitch!
45+1' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.

45+1' Mousa Al Tamari (Montpellier) decided to shoot after receiving a sweet pass. If it wasn't for Mory Diaw's superb save the ball would have probably ended up in the bottom right corner. Montpellier earn a corner.
45' 4 additional min. will be played.
44' Jordan Ferri (Montpellier) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
40' Khalil Fayad (Montpellier) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
40' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
40' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) sees his mid-range free kick perfectly saved by the goalkeeper.
38' Maximiliano Caufriez (Clermont) makes a bad challenge on his opponent and is booked by the referee.
36' Khalil Fayad (Montpellier) is penalised for a foul. Florent Batta had a clear view and blows his whistle.
32' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels low towards the middle of the target, but Mory Diaw easily deals with the threat.
31' Neto Borges (Clermont) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
28' Michel Der Zakarian almost immediately gets a second yellow card from referee Florent Batta and will have to vacate the bench!
28' Michel Der Zakarian isn't happy on the touchline after referee Florent Batta shows him a yellow card.
26' Mousa Al Tamari (Montpellier) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance.
25' Florent Batta blows his whistle as Khalil Fayad (Montpellier) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
24' Muhammed Cham (Clermont) whips the ball in from the free kick, but it goes well out of play.
24' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
22' Florent Batta blows his whistle after Jordan Ferri (Montpellier) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle. Another situation results in a direct free kick for Clermont.
18' Here comes a substitution. Maxime Esteve is given a rest as he is replaced by Khalil Fayad (Montpellier).
18' Maxime Esteve (Montpellier) looks like he won’t be able to continue.
17' Maxime Esteve (Montpellier) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
14' Montpellier have been awarded a corner kick.
14' Akor Adams (Montpellier) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
12' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) receives a pass, beats an opponent and tries a long-range shot. It's a weak effort low towards the middle of the goal and Mory Diaw easily makes the save.
12' Wahbi Khazri (Montpellier) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
11' One of the Clermont players tripped an opponent and conceded a foul.
8' Cheick Oumar Konate (Clermont) gets booked for the first time in this match.
7' 0 - 1 Nice piece of skill by Maxime Gonalons (Clermont) as he collected a pass and fired an unstoppable thunderbolt into the left side of the goal, leaving the goalkeeper stranded.
5' Falaye Sacko (Montpellier) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The ball goes out of play and Clermont will have a goal kick.
3' Mousa Al Tamari (Montpellier) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Clermont will have the kick-off.
Florent Batta got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
